Useful Information Regarding Satta Matka

Q1 What is SATTA MATKA and its importance?
Satta Matka is one of the most famous terms related to all the famous Mumbai side lottery (satta) games. Some of the most famous Matka games are Kalyan Matka, Milan day/night, Rajdhani day/night etc. In all these games, people have to predict some lucky number from 0 to 9 and bid their money on that if they win to find out today’s lucky number. They get a good amount of money from the bulky side. A Bookie is one of the agents of a lottery game company where people can bid their money on that particular lucky number. In these games, many types of bidding options are available, like a bid on a single number from 0 to 9 called “Single,” a bid on two numbers from 00 to 99 called “Jodi,” and a bid on three numbers called “Patti or panel.”
Q2 How do I use MATKA GAME?
You can use the matka game at your own risk. If you have an extra amount of money and you are able to take the risk of winning a chance of one out of ten (1/10), then you can try your luck. In order to play matka games, you have to find your local area matka agent, generally known as “Bookie”, and then you can easily play your matka games there.
Q3 Why is KALYAN MATKA so important?
Kalyan Matka has a special importance in all Mumbai side matka games because it is one of the oldest among all matka and lottery games. Everyone believes in its record and it maintains its reliability among the people of India. Kalyan Matka covers a wide area of network, not only in India but also in other countries.
Q4 Is Matka Gambling legal in India?
Matka gambling is illegal in India. As per the Public Gambling Act of 1867, both betting establishments and satta matka houses were outlawed completely. Whoever is caught playing the game will be punished. There are some countries where matka gambling is legal. They are: North America, USA, Canada, Kahnawake, Curaçao, Europe, UK, Ireland, Monaco, Belgium, Asia-Pacific, Australia, Malta, etc.
Q5 What is SATTA KING?
SATTA KING is one of the most famous terms used to identify lottery or matka games that are played in the surrounding areas of the Delhi capital, Faridabad, Ghaziabad etc. Some of the most popular games are GALI SATTA, DESAWAR SATTA, FARIDABAD SATTA, and GHAZIABAD SATTA. These markets have only one single figure called ‘Haruf’ or “Jodi” to play, which means people can play either a single figure from 0 to 9 on two sides called “Ander” and “Bahar” or a group of two numbers known as “JODI” ranging from “00” to “99”.
Q6 What is the history of SATTA MATKA games?

Satta matka is related to matka gambling and lottery, which have been very popular in India since before the country’s independence. In the past it was known as ‘ANK JUGAD’ (Figure Gambling). In the whole process of satta matka, they find a lucky number by using either of two methods — like in the past, they picked a lucky slip from a pot known as ‘MATKA’ and declared that number as a lucky number (‘Matka Result’).

In 1962 a person named ‘Kalyanji Bhagat’ started matka game named ‘Worli Matka’ that ran every day in a week. Ratan Khatri introduced ‘New Worli’ by slightly changing the rules, ran only five days a week, and it gained popularity under the name ‘Main Ratan’ matka.

Q7 How to Play Satta Matka Games?

To play SATTA MATKA, you have to find a game agent generally called a “Bookie.” You can bid on your favourite number in front of Bookie, and he forwards your lucky number bid amount to his senior Bookie. When you win, it is the responsibility of Bookie to give you your winning amount.

We can also play SATTA MATKA online by using various apps and websites. You log in, deposit money, and get points to use in various matka games. If you win, you receive winning points added to your wallet, withdrawable to your bank account, phone, or Google Pay.

Q8 How Many Types of Matka Games Are There?

Basically, there are two types of matka games: those with open and close panels and Jodi’s, referred to as SATTA MATKA games. Examples: Kalyan Matka, Milan Day, Milan Night, Rajdhani Day, Rajdhani Night, Bhootnath Day, Bhootnath Night, etc.

Another type has Ander Bahar Haruf and Jodi’s, famous as SATTA KING Games. Examples: Desawar Satta, Gali Satta, Faridabad Satta, Ghaziabad Satta, etc.

Q9 What precautions should you take while playing any Satta games?

Below are some necessary precautions you should take while playing any matka game:
